scientific_integrity: Theorems restricted to nonempty bicliques and k in {4,5}; finite orientation masks are exact certificates for twelve cases. No claim is made for broader multipartite graphs or unknown values of k.
scientific_limitations: Historical priority may require review of older star-decomposition literature.
Proof uses twelve fully included computationally discovered but independently checkable orientation certificates.
No independent external validation has been performed.
title: Sharp consecutive-star decomposition thresholds for complete bipartite graphs at sizes four and five
